ed8d8a2e7118c24b.summary: Mastering men's fragrance selection: decoding concentration (EDT vs EDP), scent families, and skin chemistry. Hook: 'Why 90% of men wear the wrong cologne: how to pick a signature scent that actually lasts.'
ed8d8a2e7118c24b.notes:
- The fragrance pyramid: top notes (citrus/aquatic, 15-30 min), heart notes (spices/florals, 2-4 hours), base notes (woody/amber/vanilla, 6-12 hours).
- Concentrations: Eau de Cologne (2-4%), Eau de Toilette (5-15%), Eau de Parfum (15-20%), Parfum (20-30%). In humid climates like India, EDP performs far better than cheap body sprays.
- Selection rule: Match scent families to environments (fresh/aquatic/citrus for office and daytime; woody/oriental/gourmand for evening and dates).
- Practical buying guide under ₹2,000–₹5,000 for young professionals.
